lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 semi-regular horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters. The density of these clusters is highest immediately posterior to the gill region, with spatial distance between centroids increasing significantly as they progress toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows, creating a rectangular grid-like arrangement. The nodes of intersection are most distinct in the central mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank. These features exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity light reflection on the superior edge and a narrow band of low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.
